```{r}
th2.list <- readRDS("~/hpchome/th2.list2.rds")
sca.list <- readRDS("~/hpchome/sca.list.rds")
canc_disc.list <- readRDS("~/hpchome/canc_disc.list.rds")
orig.list <- readRDS("~/hpchome/seurat.merged.list.rds")
```


```{r}
BiocManager::install("decontX")
library(decontX)
library(BiocParallel)

th2.list.ss <- th2.list
th2.list.ss <- lapply(th2.list.ss, function(x){
  meta <- x@meta.data
  meta <- meta[,1:3]
  x@meta.data <- meta
  return(x)
})

samples <- names(th2.list.ss)
th2.list.pp <- list()

for(i in seq_along(samples)){
  tmp <- samples[i]
  seurat_obj <- th2.list.ss[[tmp]]
  mat <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
  decont <- decontX(mat)
  
  seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = decont[["decontXcounts"]], min.cells = 3, min.features = 300, project = tmp)
  seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, nCount_RNA > 500)
  
  sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(seurat_obj)
  sce <- scDblFinder(sce, BPPARAM=MulticoreParam(16))
  doublets <- data.frame(db.class = sce$scDblFinder.class, db.score = sce$scDblFinder.score)
  rownames(doublets) <- rownames(sce@colData)
  seurat_obj <- AddMetaData(seurat_obj, doublets)
  
  seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, db.class == "singlet")
  seurat_obj@meta.data <- seurat_obj@meta.data[,1:3]
  th2.list.pp[[i]] <- seurat_obj
}

names(th2.list.pp) <- samples

th2.list.pp.merge <- merge(th2.list.pp[[1]], th2.list.pp[-1])
th2.list.pp.merge <- JoinLayers(th2.list.pp.merge)
saveRDS(th2.list.pp.merge, "~/hpchome/th2.list.pp.merge.rds")
```

```{r}
meta <- merge.all.disk@meta.data
meta$barcode.simple <- str_extract(rownames(meta), "[ACGT]+")
meta$barcode <- paste0(meta$barcode.simple, "_", meta$orig.ident)
rownames(meta) <- make.unique(meta$barcode)

colnames(merge.all.disk) <- rownames(meta)

meta.vdj.all$barcode.simple <- str_extract(rownames(meta.vdj.all), "[ACGT]+")
meta.vdj.all$barcode <- paste0(meta.vdj.all$barcode.simple, "_", meta.vdj.all$orig.ident)
rownames(meta.vdj.all) <- make.unique(meta.vdj.all$barcode)
```



```{r}
meta$barcode <- rownames(meta)
meta.vdj.all$barcode <- rownames(meta.vdj.all)

# Merge by barcode (like a SQL left join)
meta.merged <- merge(
  meta,
  meta.vdj.all[,4:11],
  by = "barcode",
  all.x = TRUE  # keep all cells from meta, fill NAs if no match in vdj
)

# Set rownames back to barcode
rownames(meta.merged) <- make.unique(meta.merged$barcode)

meta.merged <- meta.merged[colnames(merge.all.disk), ]
colnames(meta.merged)
meta.merged <- meta.merged[,-12]
# Assign back to Seurat
merge.all.disk@meta.data <- meta.merged
```
